chunks: 2814 - Hariz and Ibrahim ibn Umar narrated; they said: Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said:
“There is no harm in a woman performing tawaf while not circumcised. As for a man, he does not perform tawaf unless he is circumcised.”

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man; the ruling here concerns male pilgrims
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman; the ruling here concerns female pilgrims
key_terms.تَطُوفَ: to perform tawaf, meaning to circumambulate the Ka'bah
key_terms.غَيْرَ مَخْفُوضَةٍ: not circumcised; referring here to a female not having undergone circumcision
key_terms.مَخْتُونًا: circumcised; the condition mentioned for a man’s tawaf

ai.seo_question: Can an uncircumcised person perform tawaf in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tawaf and circumcision. It states that a woman may perform tawaf without circumcision, whereas a man is not to perform tawaf unless he is circumcised.
